title: Quick Briny Dutch Potato Fritters
description: A creamy and indulgent Dutch dish featuring tabasco sauce, with a double-fry method for crispy exterior and fluffy interior, this recipe is perfect for a snack or side dish. The addition of tabasco sauce gives it a nice spicy kick.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, onion, flour, eggs, tabasco sauce, milk, and salt, and mix well.
Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the potato mixture into the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Increase the oil temperature to 375 degrees and fry the fritters again for an additional 2-3 minutes or until crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a serving plate.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
